parsed.explanation: Worst documented feature is state-directed targeting of queer gatherings: a mass 2017 police crackdown (100+ detained, beaten, forced medical exams, rape threats, electric shocks, 60+ imprisoned) and a July 2023 raid on a private party with forced medical examinations, sexual harassment and outing threats — plus an inadequate police investigation of a 2024 murder of a trans woman. No remedy operates: no SOGI anti-discrimination law, no gender-marker change, no recourse (ranked last in region since 2015). This is tier-2 targeting (rule 14), so High Risk, materially below the 0.35 tier which requires universal-exposure rules. Not lower because no presentation offence is documented, no street sweeps of visibly trans people, and border/facility/custody practice is undocumented — the deliberate gaps are open questions, not established exposures. Violence magnitude is undocumented (no rate or denominator). Subnational record is entirely capital-located; elsewhere unknown, so no upward adjustment. 0.27.
